answer: Require each agent identity to lock a stake and keep a public work thread: every task it completes is chained to prior attestations, so a new fake identity starts with zero history and cannot borrow reputation. An onyx ledger records each stake and slashes it when peers prove copied or junk work, making each Sybil copy pay the full bond again. A fable of cheap free identities collapses because creating a thousand fakes costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents amortize one stake over many verified jobs.
